material_late_arrivals.internal_result: 720 modeled states; current high-risk familiarity-only policy allowed 3 wrong-but-authorized cases; candidate risk-sensitive evidence floor allowed 0 such cases with 0 modeled invariant failures while retaining modeled legitimate low/high-risk cases.
material_late_arrivals.external_screen: Selective-classification literature independently formalizes abstention/risk-coverage tradeoffs when mistakes are costly; it does not validate Clay's exact evidence-floor policy.
material_late_arrivals.transformed_claim: Safe effect requires both authority closure and epistemic-action closure. For high-consequence visually conditioned effects, learned familiarity alone should not be the sole causal basis unless an explicit calibrated risk guarantee satisfies the action's evidence requirement; otherwise obtain fresh action-specific observation/deeper perception or abstain.
material_late_arrivals.counterhypothesis: A sufficiently calibrated, fresh familiarity classifier with validated selective-risk guarantee may itself satisfy some high-risk evidence floors without extra sensing.
material_late_arrivals.falsifier: On realistic H1 visual-action tasks, familiarity-only with calibrated selective risk matches fresh-evidence policy on protected damage, task utility and latency.
material_late_arrivals.next_test: Ubuntu H1 false-KNOWN/high-risk factorial with valid capabilities; vary fresh observation, familiarity calibration, GWT escalation, risk class and abstention.

material_late_arrivals.internal_result: Illustrative timing model shows inline probe delay can materially lower deadline success and asymmetric instrumentation can flip competition winners; no target-host overhead was measured.
material_late_arrivals.external_screen: Linux ftrace documentation explicitly warns that tracing overhead may still occur when writes are disabled and that function tracing can extend measured latency; low-overhead tracing literature provides a competing implementation path.
material_late_arrivals.transformed_claim: Emergence/GWT/loop causal measurements on latency-sensitive mechanisms must carry probe mode and measured overhead, and decisive results should be reproduced with lower-intrusion or symmetric controls; instrumentation is part of the intervention environment when it can alter timing/order.
material_late_arrivals.counterhypothesis: On Andreas' Ubuntu target, selected low-overhead probes may be negligible relative to mechanism slack and need no correction beyond ordinary measurement uncertainty.
material_late_arrivals.falsifier: Measured target-host probe overhead produces no material winner/order/deadline/effect change across instrumented vs minimally observed matched trials.
material_late_arrivals.next_test: Ubuntu target A/B: uninstrumented external outcome oracle vs sampling/events vs armed-no-emit vs inline probes; measure overhead distribution and causal-readout drift.

material_late_arrivals.internal_result: 12,665 canonical-equivalence pairs and 2,411 compatibility-only pairs matched the candidate typed policy; global implicit NFC has an observable exact-sequence counterexample, global NFKC erases compatibility distinctions, and component-normalize-then-concat produced four normalization-boundary counterexamples.
material_late_arrivals.external_screen: Unicode UAX #15 defines canonical vs compatibility normalization, warns that system normalization strategy has tradeoffs, and current normative version is Unicode 17.0.0; the proxy used Python UCD 15.1.0.
material_late_arrivals.transformed_claim: ClayCode string identity should distinguish exact scalar-sequence semantics from explicitly normalized text semantics, with normalization form/version/policy included in semantic identity where observable; global implicit NFC/NFKC is not assumed semantics-neutral.
material_late_arrivals.counterhypothesis: ClayCode could deliberately define its generic String type as normalized Unicode text, making NFC equality normative and exact codepoint-sequence access a separate byte/scalar type.
material_late_arrivals.falsifier: A simpler single normalized String contract preserves every admitted program's observable equality/length/hash/interop behavior and passes held-out Unicode conformance.
material_late_arrivals.next_test: Normative parser/canonicalizer/evaluator Unicode corpus on Ubuntu with pinned Unicode 17 data/version and explicit exact-vs-normalized type comparisons.
